question: Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University is located at _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is **located in New Delh**i and was **formed on 8th October 1962 **as a central university.
 
• The **University Grants Commission** gave the status of being deemed to be a university to Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University in 1987.
 
• The university** specializes in teaching and research in Sanskrit and Indian philosophy.**
 
• The **primary goal **is to revive the cultural and intellectual heritage of India through Sanskrit education.
 
• It **promotes research in ancient Indian texts and traditions**, encouraging scholarly activities to preserve and propagate knowledge.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri **

 
 
• Lal Bahadur Shastri was a** pivotal figure in India's history, **serving as the country's second Prime Minister from 1964 to 1966.
 
• He was **Born on October 2, 1904,** in Uttar Pradesh, Shastri was deeply influenced by Mahatma Gandhi's non-cooperation movement 
 
• He played a **crucial role in India's freedom struggle** and later became a key leader in the Indian National Congress
 
• He** served as **Minister for Railways, Commerce and Industry, and Home Affairs before becoming Prime Minister in 1964 .
